text: Startup myths I believed before launching my app
Myth: you need funding to start.
Reality: you need a real problem and a cheap way to put a fix in front of people.
Myth: a good product markets itself.
Reality: nobody finds it unless you show it to them. Again and again.
Myth: launch day is the big moment.
Reality: launch day is day one of the actual work.
Myth: App Review is a formality.
Reality: Apple reads your terms, privacy policy and account deletion flow. Closely.
Myth: you need a big audience before you launch.
Reality: you need the right few people. Start small and specific.
Myth: you have to do it all alone.
Reality: I'm building mine with my brother. Pick one person you trust and split the work.
